title: Page Sections

fields.label: Page Sections
fields.name: page_sections
fields.instructions: Add, remove and drag-reorder sections to build this page. The same section types can be used multiple times per page in any order.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap the highlighted words in **double asterisks**, e.g. The Smarter Way to Move **Your Money**
sub_fields.default_value: The Smarter Way to Move **Your Money**

sub_fields.label: Pill 1 Text
sub_fields.name: pill_1_text
sub_fields.default_value: Riba-free principles and protected by bank-grade

sub_fields.label: Pill 2 Text
sub_fields.name: pill_2_text
sub_fields.default_value: Utilities & Transfers all in one place

sub_fields.label: Hero Style
sub_fields.name: hero_style
sub_fields.instructions: "Business" adds a subheading, two buttons, and repositions the pills top-right/bottom-left, matching business.html's richer hero. "Inner Page" is the shorter, centered-heading hero used on Debit Card, Deen, Payroll, Safa, Tijarat, Aghaaz, What's New, and Connect — it has a reduced height and its own desktop/mobile background images instead of the app mockup and pills.

sub_fields.label: Mobile Background Image
sub_fields.name: mobile_bg_image
sub_fields.instructions: Used below the 575px breakpoint instead of Background Image. Leave blank to fall back to the generic bg-1.png.

sub_fields.label: Subheading
sub_fields.name: subheading
sub_fields.default_value: Scale your business with Pakistan’s premium Shariah-compliant digital financial network.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.
sub_fields.default_value: Experience a **borderless** **digital** wallet where Shariah compliance meets high **velocity banking**

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

sub_fields.label: Custom Grid Layout
sub_fields.name: custom_grid
sub_fields.instructions: Used on the Business page (only 3 cards) — makes the 3rd card span the full width as a featured card, matching business.html.

sub_fields.label: Card Size Pattern
sub_fields.name: card_pattern
sub_fields.instructions: Cards repeat in pairs — this sets which size comes first, repeating every 4 cards (1&2, 5&6, ... vs 3&4, 7&8, ...).

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. If set, the whole card becomes clickable.

sub_fields.label: Show Button
sub_fields.name: show_button
sub_fields.instructions: Adds a single button centered below the card grid (e.g. "See More").

layout_aik_smarter_section.name: smarter_section
layout_aik_smarter_section.label: Smarter Section (Feature/Spend/Why-Choose block)
layout_aik_smarter_section.instructions: The main reusable content block — add this as many times as needed per page, in any order, for hero-style feature/benefit sections.

sub_fields.label: Top Logo/Image (optional)
sub_fields.name: top_image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional small logo/image shown above the Heading (e.g. the aik Tijarat logo). Leave blank for sections that don't need one.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: Plain paragraph, optional. Shown above Bullet List Items if both are filled in — e.g. an intro line before a "Why Choose" / "Key Features" list. Leave blank for list-only sections. Wrap words in **double asterisks** to highlight them in yellow, or __double underscores__ for plain bold (no color change), same as the Heading field.

sub_fields.label: Bullet List Items
sub_fields.name: list_items
sub_fields.instructions: For "Why Choose" / "Key Features" style sections — renders as a bulleted list with the item heading highlighted in yellow, e.g. "Instant Savings at Checkout: There is no need to wait...", shown below Description if that's also filled in. Don't type a trailing colon in the heading, it's added automatically. Leave Item Heading blank for a plain bullet (e.g. just "Cash flow") with no yellow label or colon.

sub_fields.label: Icon Grid Items
sub_fields.name: icon_items
sub_fields.instructions: Optional row of icon + label items shown below the Description/Bullet List (e.g. Deen page's Azaan Alerts / Qibla Direction / Digital Quran row). Wraps 5-per-row on desktop and fewer per row automatically on smaller screens.

sub_fields.label: Media Type
sub_fields.name: media_type
sub_fields.instructions: Choose whether the side column below shows the Image or the Video field.

sub_fields.label: Video
sub_fields.name: video
sub_fields.instructions: Self-hosted video file (mp4/webm/mov). Plays muted, autoplay, looped, with no controls — matches the site's decorative video treatment.

sub_fields.label: Image/Video Position
sub_fields.name: image_position
sub_fields.instructions: Applies to whichever media type is selected above.

sub_fields.label: Background Style
sub_fields.name: background_style
sub_fields.instructions: Most sections use "Default" (the dark textured smarter_bg.png overlay seen throughout the site). Use "None" for plain white/transparent sections (e.g. Debit Card's "Your Key to Everyday Savings"). Use "Custom Image" for text-only sections with their own full background image (e.g. "Start Saving Today").

sub_fields.label: Background Image (Mobile)
sub_fields.name: bg_image_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Optional — shown below 768px instead of the desktop image above (e.g. debit_saving-mb.png). Leave blank to reuse the desktop image on mobile too.

sub_fields.label: Show Notes
sub_fields.name: show_notes
sub_fields.instructions: Small callout line(s) below the buttons, e.g. a disclaimer or caveat — each with its own optional heading (e.g. "Note").

sub_fields.label: Notes
sub_fields.name: notes
sub_fields.instructions: Add as many as needed — each renders as its own line, e.g. "Note: ...".

sub_fields.label: Note Heading
sub_fields.name: note_heading
sub_fields.instructions: Optional label, e.g. "Note". Don't type a trailing colon, it's added automatically.

sub_fields.label: Extra CSS Class (advanced)
sub_fields.name: extra_class
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Only set this if design/QA asks for a specific per-page style hook (mirrors modifier classes like debit_custom_smarter-sec from the original design).

layout_aik_full_width_video.name: full_width_video
layout_aik_full_width_video.label: Full-Width Video (edge-to-edge, no container)
layout_aik_full_width_video.instructions: A standalone video section with no side padding/container — the video always spans the full page width, unlike the Smarter Section's Video option which sits inside the boxed layout next to text.

sub_fields.label: Video
sub_fields.name: video
sub_fields.instructions: Self-hosted video file (mp4/webm/mov). Plays muted, autoplay, looped, with no controls.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

sub_fields.label: Testimonials
sub_fields.name: testimonials
sub_fields.instructions: Pick and order the testimonials to show. Manage testimonial content under the Testimonials menu.

layout_aik_download_band.name: download_band
layout_aik_download_band.label: App Download (Band Design + Mobile)
layout_aik_download_band.instructions: Newer 'App Download' design (the wide decorative-band layout from index.html) — a separate layout from the original 'App Download' above so existing pages using that one aren't affected. Renders a desktop version and a mobile version from the same fields; only one shows per screen size.

sub_fields.label: Show Help Search
sub_fields.name: show_help_search
sub_fields.instructions: Adds a "How May We Help You?" heading + search bar directly above the download band, sharing its background with no gap (e.g. index.html's Home page). The search submits to the site's built-in WordPress search.

sub_fields.label: Phone Image (Mobile)
sub_fields.name: phone_image_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Optional — leave blank to reuse the desktop Phone Image on mobile too.

sub_fields.label: Background Band Image (Desktop)
sub_fields.name: bg_band_image
sub_fields.instructions: The decorative teal band graphic behind the phone/QR on desktop. Leave blank to use the theme default.

sub_fields.label: Background Image (Mobile)
sub_fields.name: bg_image_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Full-bleed background for the stacked mobile layout. Leave blank to use the theme default.

sub_fields.label: Number of Posts
sub_fields.name: count
sub_fields.instructions: Leave blank (or 0) to show every post automatically — no need to update this each time a new one is published. Set a number only if you want to cap the preview to fewer posts than actually exist.

layout_aik_steps.name: steps
layout_aik_steps.label: Steps (How-To / Order Process)
layout_aik_steps.instructions: Numbered step cards (e.g. "How to Order Your aik Card") — a fixed set of steps you enter directly, not real WordPress Posts. Don't use the News layout for this; News pulls from Posts and renders date/Read More/See More, which doesn't match this section's design.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

sub_fields.label: Cards Per Row
sub_fields.name: columns
sub_fields.instructions: How many step cards sit side by side on desktop.

sub_fields.label: Title/Description Text Color
sub_fields.name: text_color
sub_fields.instructions: "Default" keeps the alternating yellow/green title color per card. "White" makes every card's title and description white instead. The numbered badge is unaffected either way.

sub_fields.label: Steps
sub_fields.name: steps_list
sub_fields.instructions: Renders as numbered cards (01, 02, 03…) in a row (see Cards Per Row above), alternating the accent color every other card — matches the original design automatically, nothing to set per-step for that.

layout_aik_faq.name: faq
layout_aik_faq.label: FAQs (Accordion)
layout_aik_faq.instructions: A collapsible question/answer list. The first item is open by default; clicking a question opens it and closes whichever one was open.

sub_fields.label: Answer
sub_fields.name: answer
sub_fields.instructions: Use the toolbar for bold text, bullet/numbered lists and links (select text, click the link icon).

sub_fields.label: Show Button
sub_fields.name: show_button
sub_fields.instructions: Optional "See More" button centered below the list.

layout_aik_pif_form.name: pif_form
layout_aik_pif_form.label: Partner Inquiry Form
layout_aik_pif_form.instructions: Renders the fixed Partner Inquiry Form (name/email/mobile/company/service/message) — only the heading and subtext are editable here; submissions are handled by inc/forms.php and stored under Partner Inquiries.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

sub_fields.label: Subtext
sub_fields.name: subtext
sub_fields.default_value: Take control of your data, simplify your integrations, and see what a dedicated open banking vertical can do for your organization. Partner with aik Connect today to build the future of your corporate business infrastructure.

layout_aik_feedback_form.name: feedback_form
layout_aik_feedback_form.label: Feedback Form
layout_aik_feedback_form.instructions: Renders the fixed Feedback Form (name/email/mobile/product/query type/message) — only the heading and subtext are editable here; submissions are handled by inc/forms.php and stored under Feedback. Same visual language as the Partner Inquiry Form but a separate component.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

sub_fields.label: Subtext
sub_fields.name: subtext
sub_fields.default_value: We're eager to hear from you and address any queries you may have.

layout_aik_schedule_of_charges.name: schedule_of_charges
layout_aik_schedule_of_charges.label: Schedule of Charges (PDF library)
layout_aik_schedule_of_charges.instructions: Document library grid, 3 cards per row — cards reuse the same .news-single design as "Our Media News" (main.css), with a PDF icon in place of a post thumbnail. Add one row per document; each is a real PDF upload.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

sub_fields.label: Subtitle
sub_fields.name: subtitle
sub_fields.default_value: Download the latest fee and charges schedule for aik digital's accounts and services.

sub_fields.label: Thumbnail Image
sub_fields.name: thumbnail
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave blank to show a plain PDF icon instead.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. "Schedule of Charges — Personal Banking".

layout_aik_help_section.name: help_section
layout_aik_help_section.label: We're Here to Help (contact info block)
layout_aik_help_section.instructions: Standalone contact/help block — heading, intro line, a list of Call Us/Email Us/Visit Us style info items, and an image on the right that bleeds to the section's bottom edge. Deliberately separate from Smarter Section rather than another variant on it.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

sub_fields.label: Intro Line
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.default_value: Have a question, need some help or want to know more about aik? Get in touch with us.

sub_fields.label: Info Items
sub_fields.name: items
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. Call Us / Email Us / Visit Us / Need Help With Something Specific?

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: item_title
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave blank for an item that's just a bold line + description (e.g. "Need Help With Something Specific?").

sub_fields.label: Bold Text
sub_fields.name: item_bold
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. "UAN: 111 245 475", an email address, "Head Office".

sub_fields.label: Bold Text Link
sub_fields.name: item_bold_link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. If set, the Bold Text above becomes a link — e.g. mailto:support@aikdigital.io or tel:111245475. (A plain Text field, not ACF's URL field, since ACF's URL field rejects mailto:/tel: links.)

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Right-side image — bleeds down to the section's bottom edge.

sub_fields.label: Extra CSS Class (advanced)
sub_fields.name: extra_class
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Only set this if design/QA asks for a specific per-page style hook.

layout_aik_feature_suite.name: feature_suite
layout_aik_feature_suite.label: Feature Suite Slider
layout_aik_feature_suite.instructions: Autoplaying content/image slider (e.g. "Explore Our Feature Suite"). Standalone component, its own layout rather than a Smarter Section variant. Each slide can independently put its image on the left or right.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

sub_fields.label: Background Style
sub_fields.name: background_style
sub_fields.instructions: "Default" is the dark green section (heading/tagline/text in white and yellow). "White" switches to a plain white background with the heading/tagline/text in green instead — highlighted **words** stay yellow either way.

sub_fields.label: Background Image
sub_fields.name: background_image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Full-bleed background for the whole section (gradient/texture/decoration all baked into one image). Leave blank for a plain dark green background. Only used with the "Default" Background Style above.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**, e.g. "RAAST **QR** Payments".

sub_fields.label: Tagline
sub_fields.name: tagline
sub_fields.instructions: Short yellow highlight line under the title, e.g. "Say Goodbye to Cash: Accept RAAST QR Payments Instantly".

sub_fields.label: Bullet List Items
sub_fields.name: list_items
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Item Heading renders bold/yellow, e.g. "Scan to Pay: Let customers make lightning-fast payments...". Don't type a trailing colon, it's added automatically.

sub_fields.label: Extra CSS Class (advanced)
sub_fields.name: extra_class
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Only set this if design/QA asks for a specific per-page style hook.

layout_aik_explore_guest.name: explore_guest
layout_aik_explore_guest.label: Explore aik Before You Sign Up
layout_aik_explore_guest.instructions: Standalone content/image block (e.g. "Explore aik Before You Sign Up") — heading, description, a subheading + bullet list, a second subheading, a button, and an image on the right. Deliberately separate from Smarter Section rather than another variant on it.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**. A manual Enter creates a line break — e.g. "Explore aik Before\n**You Sign Up**" puts the second line entirely in yellow.

sub_fields.label: Bullet List Items
sub_fields.name: list_items
sub_fields.instructions: Plain bulleted list — no bold label, just the item text.

sub_fields.label: Closing Blocks
sub_fields.name: closing_blocks
sub_fields.instructions: One or more title + description + button blocks, shown below the Bullet List (e.g. "Experience aik. Join when you're ready." + an "Explore as a Guest" button). Add more than one if this section needs a second closing block later.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.default_value: Experience aik. Join when you're ready.

sub_fields.label: Extra CSS Class (advanced)
sub_fields.name: extra_class
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Only set this if design/QA asks for a specific per-page style hook.

layout_aik_send_money.name: send_money
layout_aik_send_money.label: Send Money Your Way (solid card grid)
layout_aik_send_money.instructions: Standalone component (own .send-money-* namespace) — a centered heading above a grid of solid green cards, 3 per row, each just a title + description (no image). Not connected to News posts in any way.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap highlighted words in **double asterisks**.

description: Flexible Content builder for all front-end pages. Each layout renders via template-parts/blocks/{layout-name}.php.
